text: Grab's Deliveries segment generated **$1,800 million (≈$1.8 billion)** in revenue in FY2025, up 21% from $1,493 million in FY2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.97]. This growth was driven by a 21% increase in deliveries GMV to $14.2 billion, higher platform engagement, and a $161 million contribution increase from the supermarket business (including Everrise), with deliveries revenue remaining steady at 13% of GMV in both years [Grab, FY2025, p.98].

answer: Grab's Deliveries segment generated **$1,800 million (≈$1.8 billion)** in revenue in FY2025, up 21% from $1,493 million in FY2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.97]. This growth was driven by a 21% increase in deliveries GMV to $14.2 billion, higher platform engagement, and a $161 million contribution increase from the supermarket business (including Everrise), with deliveries revenue remaining steady at 13% of GMV in both years [Grab, FY2025, p.98].
